method: every recording of eval/dev and eval/control whose spoken name is on the full 2023 ISMP list, degraded four ways: the telephone band alone (300 to 3400 Hz, 8 kHz mu-law, back to 16 kHz PCM for the socket), the same with Gaussian noise at 10 dB and at 5 dB SNR against the active speech level, and the same sped up by 1.1 with ffmpeg atempo; noise seed 20260925
caveat: desktop TTS voices, not human speech; the noise is white, not a room; eval/native16 is left out because it repeats the 40 control terms and voices with only the resampler changed
